name: Junction
notes: Release build of Junction.app (ad-hoc signed) with its audio driver, routing helper and driver installer inside, the engine tests and the driver harness, and a self-test that checks the bundled driver loads, both helpers are bundled and signed, and the planner, kernel (with effect chains and an Apple Audio Unit), both helpers' XPC messages, crash reports and saving work; then copies Junction.app into /Applications/omso.
Installing the driver itself is a separate step in the app (administrator password, restarts Core Audio).

These builds route inside the app and install the driver with the password (ROUTING_HELPER and DRIVER_DAEMON default to 0); nothing is registered with launchd. They have no CRASH_REPORT_URL: crash reports, when turned on, are copied, not sent.
